info.title: Computational Toxicology and Exposure Data APIs - Chemical
info.description: The Chemical APIs are part of a set of public computational toxicology and exposure APIs and provide a variety of chemical information through a set of API endpoints. These APIs allow users to easily access and utilize a wide range of chemical information, including the ability to: search for chemicals, retrieve chemical structure files in various formats, access both experimental and predictive chemical properties, obtain fate data, and access other chemical-related data.

tags.name: Chemical Details Resource
tags.description: API endpoints for collecting data for given chemical(s).

tags.name: Extra Data Resource
tags.description: API endpoints for returning extra data relating to chemical(s) identified by DTXSID(s)

tags.name: Wikipedia link to GHS Classification
tags.description: API endpoints for checking if chemical has GHS classification safety data in Wikipedia.

tags.name: Chemical Property Resource
tags.description: API endpoints for getting chemical properties (experimental and/or predictive) for a given DTXSID (Chemical Identifier).

tags.name: Pubchem link to GHS Classification
tags.description: API endpoints for checking if chemical has GHS classification safety data in Pubchem.

tags.name: Chemical Search Resource
tags.description: API endpoints for searching chemicals using different identifiers or characteristics.

tags.name: Chemical List Resource
tags.description: API endpoints for getting chemical lists and chemicals in those lists.

tags.name: OPSIN Resource
tags.description: API endpoints for getting chemical structure data through Systematic IUPAC name using OPSIN.

tags.name: Chemical File Resource
tags.description: API endpoints for getting chemical structure data in mol, mrv and image (png or svg format) for given Chemical Identifier (DTXSID or DTXCID).

tags.name: Chemical Synonym Resource
tags.description: API endpoints for getting chemical synonym for given DTXSID (Chemical Identifier).

tags.name: Indigo Service
tags.description: API endpoints for getting chemical info from Indigo Toolkit.
